The Assistant Commissioner of Police, MICO Layout Sub-Division, Bangalore City, has submitted charge sheet against the accused persons for the offence punishable U/s.498A and 304-B of Indian Penal Code and Sec.3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act in Crime No.198/2014 of Hulimavu P.S.

sentences.text:
The brief story of the prosecution are as under:
The accused No.1 married the deceased Smt.Savitha on 16.12.2011 at Hemareddy Mallamma Karyalaya, Vijayapura.
Before marriage as per the demand, accused persons received Rs.3 lakhs and at the time of marriage Rs.1 lakh and 250 gm. gold ornaments and 2 kg silver.

After marriage, the deceased and accused persons are started to reside at Plot No.B-506, Janavi Shelter Apartment, Akshayanagar,
B.G.Road.

After some time, the accused persons started to harass the deceased by demanding additional dowry of Rs.6 lakhs, due to which the deceased on 24.03.2014 in the night unable to tolerate the torture of accused persons had committed suicide by hanging herself to the ceiling fan in the bed room at her matrimonial home with veil and thereby the accused persons have committed the offences as alleged against them.
3. The concerned police have submitted charge sheet before the concerned ACMM., Bangalore.
The learned Magistrate has took cognizance of the offences and committed the case to the Sessions Court by complying Sec.207 of Cr.P.C. after furnishing copy of charge sheet to the accused.

The same was numbered as SC No.1236/2014.
4.
The prosecution has examined seven witnesses as PW.1 to PW.7 and got marked documents at Ex.P1 to P17 and MO.1.
On consent of accused counsel, Inquest Mahazar, Post Mortem report, death Memo and FSL Report have been marked at Ex.P.7 to Ex.P10 respectively.
As such the learned PP has gave up the witness CW.18 to 21, 23 to 25.
This court has issued summons and warrant against C.Ws.5 to 8, 10 to 12, 14 to 16.
Inspite of that, the concerned police failed to execute the same and keep present of C.Ws.5 to 8, 10 to 12, 14 to 16 before the court.
As such the prayer of the learned public prosecutor was rejected and the witnesses C.Ws.5 to 8, 10 to 12, 14 to 16 were dropped.

However the liberty has given to the prosecution for examination of C.Ws.5 to 8, 10 to 12, 14 to 16, if the concerned police keep present the said witnesses before the court before conclusion of the trial.
5. After completion of prosecution side evidence, this Court has recorded the statements of accused persons, as provided U/s.313 of Cr.P.C.
The accused persons have denied incriminating evidence present against them and not claimed any defense evidence nor submitted anything to Court.

6. Heard the arguments on both sides and perused the materials on record.
7.
The following points that arises for consideration of this court:

1. Whether the prosecution proves that the accused No.1 on 16.12.2011 got married the deceased Smt.Savitha at Hemareddy Mallamma Karyalaya, Vijapura, before marriage as per the demand, accused persons received Rs.3 lakhs and at the time of marriage Rs.1 lakh and 250 gm.
gold ornaments and 2 kg silver, later residing at Plot No.B-506, Janavi Shelter Apartment,
Akshayanagar, B.G.Road, later the accused persons started to harass the deceased by demanding additional dowry of Rs.6 lakhs and thereby the accused persons have committed the offence punishable under Sec.3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act?

2. Whether the prosecution proves that the accused on No.1 on 16.12.2011 got married the deceased Smt.Savitha at Hemareddy Mallamma Karyalaya, Vijapura, before marriage as per the demand,
accused persons received Rs.3 lakhs and at the time of marriage Rs.1 lakh and 250 gm. gold ornaments and 2 kg silver, later residing at Plot No.B-506, Janavi Shelter Apartment,
Akshayanagar, B.G.Road, later the accused persons started to harass the deceased by demanding additional dowry of Rs.6 lakhs and subjected her to physical and mental cruelty and thereby the accused persons have committed the offence punishable under Sec.498A r/w.34 of IPC?
3.

Whether the prosecution proves that the accused persons started to harass the deceased by demanding additional dowry of Rs.6 lakhs and subjected her to physical and mental cruelty due to which the deceased on 24.03.2014 in the night unable to tolerate the torture of accused persons deceased Smt.Savitha had committed suicide by hanging herself to the ceiling fan in the bed room of her matrimonial home with veil and such cruelty and harassment as did drive the said deceased Smt.Savitha to commit suicide within 7 years of marriage and thereby the accused has committed the offence punishable under Section 304B r/w.34 of IPC?
4. What order?
8. This Court has answered the above above points are as under:
 Point No.1: In the Negative  Point No.2: In the Negative  Point No.3: In the Negative  Point No.4:

sentences.text: Points No.1 to 3: These points are taken up together as they are related to each other and to avoid repetition in the discussion.

The burden is on the prosecution to prove the allegations against the accused persons that the accused have tortured the deceased Savitha physically and mentally to bring additional dowry of Rs.6 lakhs.

Due to the continuous torture of the accused persons drive the deceased Savitha to commit suicide and thereby on 24.03.2014 in the night deceased has committed suicide by hanging herself to the ceiling fan in the room at matrimonial home and succumbed to death.
10. To prove the said allegations, the prosecution has examined the parents of the deceased by name Basavanagowda Gorabala and Shantha and sister by name Dr.Sunitha as PWs.1 to 3 respectively.

The evidence given by the said witnesses PWs.1 to 3 being family members clearly reveals that the marriage of accused No.1 with the deceased was performed on 16.12.2011 at Hemareddy Mallamma Mangala Kalyana Mantapa, Vijayapura by the parents of the deceased.

It is also an admitted fact that after marriage both deceased and accused No.1 started to reside in Janavi Shelter Apartment,
Plot No.506 at Akshayanagar, B.G.Road.

Except the marriage ceremony, the said witnesses PWs.1 to 3 not at all deposed anything regarding alleged physical and mental torture given by the accused to the deceased for additional dowry of Rs.6 lakhs.
According to these witnesses, both deceased and accused No.1 were leading their marital life very happily and they do not know the reasons for committing suicide by the deceased.

However the prosecution though got exhibited the complaint,
wedding card, photos, bills of marriage hall of the deceased and accused No.1 at Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.6 through Sri.Basavanna Gowda, who is the father of deceased, but it is the say of the said P.W.1 that he has not acquainted with the contents of Ex.P.1 and he has not stated in the complaint that his daughter committed suicide due to the dowry harassment as alleged against the accused persons.
So, the evidence given by P.W.1 is completely contrary to the evidence of P.W.7 B.N.Obalesh, who is one of the Investigation Officer in the present case.
Even the other family members of the deceased i.e mother Shantha and elder sister Sunitha has also not deposed in support of the prosecution story as required.
So, it is very clear that the evidence given by the family members of the deceased are not at all helpful for the prosecution in any angle.
11. It is necessary to note that the pancha witness by name Deeraj Kumar.S got examined as P.W.4 who has identified his signature present on Ex.P.11 Mahazar as Ex.P.11(a).
According to him he has signed his signature in Hulimavu police station.
12. The another witness P.W.5 by name Balakrishna has deposed that deceased and accused No.1 were residing in the Apartment, where he was residing.

He has also not and he also not supported the case of the prosecution, since he has not much acquainted with the differences between the deceased and the accused No.1 and do not know the exact reason as to why the deceased has committed suicide.
The learned PP has cross-examined the witnesses PWs.1 to 5 with the permission of the court by treating them as hostile, but unable to get any worthful evidence in support of the prosecution story.

So, the evidence given by all the independent witnesses including Hulimavu Ps vs Neelakanta Reddy on 18 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91948083/
4 family members of the deceased are not trust worthy and reliable to believe the allegations made against the accused.
13. It is obvious to note that on consent of the accused inquest Mahazar, P.M.Report, death Memo and FSL Report have been marked at Exs.P.7 to 10.
But the evidence given by the independent witnesses completely contrary to the said documents.

As such though the above documents marked on consent of accused persons, but not serve any purpose due to contrary evidence given by the prime independent witnesses especially family members of the deceased.
14. In this case the prosecution examined the Investigation Officer by name S.Siddegowda as P.W.6 and another Investigation Officer Mr.Oblesh as P.W.7.
The evidence of P.W.6 Siddegowda clearly reveals that on 25.03.2014 at 1.00 p.m the complainant came to the police station and lodged complaint.
On the basis of the complaint, he has registered FIR and sent the FIR to the court.
He has also visited the spot immediately after registering the FIR marked at Ex.P.13 and conducted Mahazars at spot as per Ex.P.11 and 14.
Later he gave requisition to Tahasildar to conduct Inquest Mahazar on the dead body of the deceased, he has deputed three 3 police staff to trace the accused persons.
On same day at 4.30 p.m produced accused No.1 and submitted report as per Ex.P.15.
He has arrested said accused and seized two Nokia mobile phones and accordingly conducted Mahazar as per Ex.P.11 and got marked Nokia company key pad mobile at M.O.1.
The sister of accused No.1 surrenered the gold ornaments and articles of the deceased in the police station and it was returned to C.W.1 and received letter, which is marked at Ex.P.16.
Later, he has handed over the further investigation to C.W.26.
The evidence of the said witness has completely denied by the counsel for the accused persons.
15. The another police witness Obalesha retired SP after receiving further investigation from P.W.6 on 28.03.2014 has continued the investigation.

He has collected the P.M.Report, clothes of deceased and visara alongwith report and the said report is marked at Ex.P.17 and brought the M.Os into PF and the P.M.Report Ex.P.8 kept in the file, on 30.03.2014 he has recorded the statements of CWs.12 and 13, on 03.04.2014 he sent the visara, clothes to FSL for chemical examination, on 13.05.2014, he has collected the wedding card, photos and marriage hall documents and kept in the file as per Ex.P.2 to 6, on 12.06.2014 he has received the FSL report as per Ex.P.10.
Thereafter, as the investigation was completed, submitted charge sheet against the accused persons.
The evidence given by the said Investigation Officer has completely denied by the counsel for accused persons.

So,
it is very clear that the evidence given by both the Investigation Officers i.e. PWs.6 and 7 does not match or corroborate with the evidence of independent witnesses.

So, it is very clear that the prosecution has completely failed to place acceptable evidence to believe that due to physical and mental torture of the accused persons towards the deceased to bring additional dowry of Rs.6 lakhs,
the deceased has committed suicide.
As such, this court has answered the point Nos.1 to 3 in the Negative.
16. Point No.4:

In view of answer of this court on points No.1 to 3, this court proceed to pass the following:

The bail bonds and surety bonds of accused persons stand cancelled.
